transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Lt. Morgan, the Distribution Platoon Leader. I need to finalize the manifest for our single lift moving four cargo lots: Medical, Repair Parts, Water, and Signal Batteries. Before I sign off, I need to hear from each of you on any current changes. We know the standard manifest has 4 pallets of Repair Parts, 5 of Water, and 2 of Signal Batteries — 11 pallets before Medical is added. I also understand the approved truck capacities may differ from the normal 8-pallet ratings. Can the warehouse lead confirm the Medical lot quantity from the release? And can the motor pool lead confirm the current approved capacities for Truck 1 and Truck 2?
